تعترضوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِضُوا (taʕtariḍū) /taʕ.ta.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# تُعْتَرَضُوا (tuʕtaraḍū) /tuʕ.ta.ra.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
